TeamClaw 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a high-performance agent subsystem for complex multi-agent orchestration, automated computer tasks, and real-time visual monitoring with a dedicated Web UI.
- Provides multi-tool conversational agents, an OASIS forum for expert collaboration, scheduled task management, mobile push notifications, and a full-featured chat frontend.
- Scripts are non-interactive and managed via a unified shell entrypoint for setup, status, user management, and configuration.
- Offers OpenAI-compatible API endpoints, diverse agent types, and multiple agent orchestration modes (discussion/execution, sync/detach).
- Extensive configuration options documented for agent, scheduling, notification, and integration with external services like OpenClaw.
